body: The increasing demand for GPU-accelerated machine learning inference has exposed limitations in centralized GPU infrastructures, including high cost, limited elasticity, and long wait times under resource constraints. At the same time, modern Apple Silicon–based macOS devices are equipped with powerful GPUs that remain largely idle during normal usage. This paper presents Minions, a dynamic and distributed virtual GPU cloud that aggregates idle Apple Silicon GPUs across macOS devices to execute large-scale machine learning inference workloads. summaryZh: 针对集中式GPU基础设施成本高、弹性受限的问题，苹果机器学习团队推出了Minions项目。该项目构建了一个动态且分布式的虚拟GPU云，能够聚合闲置的Apple Silicon macOS设备来执行大规模机器学习推理工作负载。这一创新方案为缓解算力紧张、降低推理成本提供了高效的分布式计算路径。
